description: NaBaWSbO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.99 Å. Ba is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent SbO₆ octahedra. All Ba-O bond lengths are 2.99 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.96 Å. Sb is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent BaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sb-O bond lengths are 2.27 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ba, one W, and one Sb atom.
